message: Vector Rebel 3.2.59 identifies Standard SCBA Inspection template 113271 with 11 questions and prefills confirmed Passed answers on each eligible airpack.
releaseNotes: Live authenticated Vector confirms Standard SCBA Frame pool 299946, official SCBA Inspection template 113271, and 11 Pass/Fail questions (not the separate seven-question SCBA mask PPE form). For every physically confirmed Present / Working airpack, the program opens the native item in the same tab, verifies the exact template and 11-question order, then preselects all 11 Passed answers ONCE. The operator reviews and submits each official form; exceptions remain manual. No form is auto-submitted and receipt status is not fabricated.
